prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1376; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss for a left-turn collision at an intersection. Insured vehicle was turning left when it was struck by an oncoming vehicle. Police report requested. Insured reports minor airbag deployment and claimant reportedly hit head on the window frame.

Entry 2: Claimant has retained counsel. All further contact to be directed to the attorney's office. Requested medical authorization and prior treatment records through counsel. Noted that claimant is reporting concussion symptoms including headache, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating.

Entry 3: Reviewed scene photos and statements from both drivers. Each driver describes a green signal for their direction, creating a disputed liability picture. Witness statement obtained from a pedestrian who saw the oncoming vehicle approach at speed. Liability assessment pending.

Entry 4: Counsel's office provided initial medical summary showing emergency department visit following the collision and referral to neurology. Follow-up imaging and cognitive assessment have been requested. Reserve adjusted to reflect possible extended treatment period for the concussion claim.

Entry 5: Spoke with defense liaison regarding comparative fault arguments. Vehicle telematics requested to verify speed of the oncoming vehicle. Claim remains open pending neurology report, telematics data, and resolution of liability dispute. Next review scheduled upon receipt of outstanding documents.
